sentences.en: The JumpStart Coalition did a survey of American high school seniors on their financial literacy, and the score was 53 percent.

sentences.en: Use them by themselves to accompany a special photo or as a way to jumpstart your scrapbook journaling.

sentences.en: While you can use standard cake pans to achieve wonderfully creative Easter Cakes, there are also numerous novelty cake pans that can give you a jumpstart for your designs, and most come with decorating directions.

sentences.en: Games like Brain Age, the Jumpstart series, and Oregon Trail all help children and adults alike learn many things like math, reading, history, and so much more.

sentences.en: Percolator-A stainless steel percolator is a must-have for those chilly mornings when you need a jumpstart to your active day.
